title: You Can't Take It With You
description: An eccentric patriarch meets the stuffy parents of his granddaughter's fiancé.

title: In Cold Blood
description: Two ex-convicts (Robert Blake, Scott Wilson) are tried for the savage killing of a farm family in 1959 Kansas.

title: The Big Heat
description: When his investigation into a corrupt cop's suicide spawns a car bombing that takes the life of his wife, Police Sergeant Dave Bannion quits the force to pursue the case on his own.

title: His Girl Friday
description: An ace reporter's editor, her ex-husband, tries everything possible to stop her from remarrying someone else.

title: Queen Bee
description: A boozing Atlanta millionaire's (Barry Sullivan) wicked wife (Joan Crawford) acts charming to people at their mansion.

title: 711 Ocean Drive
description: A telephone repairman (Edmond O'Brien) becomes the boss of a gambling syndicate he has ingeniously wired for profit.

title: 5 Against the House
description: Friends (Guy Madison, Kim Novak, Brian Keith) join a college student's scheme to rob a Reno casino for kicks.

title: The Cockleshell Heroes
description: A British major (Jose Ferrer) and captain (Trevor Howard) lead marines in canoes on a mission to mine Nazi ships in Bordeaux.

title: American Madness
description: The president (Walter Huston) of a bank believes in lending money to anyone who needs it.

title: The Collector
description: A British butterfly collector kidnaps an art student, Miranda Grey, and keeps her in his farmhouse cellar.

title: Miss Grant Takes Richmond
description: A bookie's (William Holden) innocent new secretary (Lucille Ball) thinks she's working in a real-estate office.

title: The Whole Truth
description: A Hollywood producer's (Stewart Granger) wife (Donna Reed) does not believe he has stabbed his actress lover, another man's (George Sanders) wife.

title: Hellcats of the Navy
description: A submarine commander (Ronald Reagan) enters the Sea of Japan with a frogman who had flirted with his girlfriend (Nancy Davis).

title: The Game That Kills
description: A man infiltrates a hockey team to investigate the death of his brother, the team's star left wing.

title: Bonjour tristesse
description: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. However, the arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend soon turns her world upside down.

title: The Bitter Tea of General Yen
description: A U.S. missionary (Barbara Stanwyck) is gradually seduced by a courtly warlord (Nils Asther) holding her in Shanghai.

title: Port Afrique
description: An American (Phil Carey) returns to Morocco and discovers his wife's past while probing her death.

title: The Undercover Man
description: Two Treasury agents (Glenn Ford, James Whitmore) set out to nail a mobster for tax evasion.

title: Murderers' Row
description: A secret agent blocks a villain's helio-beam plot in the second of four Matt Helm movies.

title: Scandal Sheet
description: When a New York tabloid editor (Broderick Crawford) accidentally kills his wife, his best reporters (Donna Reed, John Derek) figure it out.

title: Hook, Line and Sinker
description: A man (Jerry Lewis) runs up a fortune in bills after his doctor (Peter Lawford) tells him he has only months to live.

title: Only Angels Have Wings
description: A sassy chorus girl (Jean Arthur) falls in love with a seat-of-the-pants pilot (Cary Grant) in South America.

title: Boots Malone
description: Has-been agent Boots Malone (William Holden) is dodging his creditors and living on the edge of the horse racing world when wealthy teenager Tommy Gibson (Johnny Stewart) asks Malone to take him under his wing as a jockey-in-training.

title: The Black Knight
description: A common swordsmith (Alan Ladd) freelances for King Arthur to prove himself worthy of an earl's daughter (Patricia Medina).

title: The Daring Young Man
description: After the military turns him down as being unfit, a man proves himself a hero by cracking a Nazi spy ring.

title: All Ashore
description: Three sailors celebrate their shore leave in grand style by taking off on a spree to Catalina Island.

title: The Taming of the Shrew
description: Shakespeare's Petruchio weds Katharina on his own terms in Padua.

title: Don't Knock the Twist
description: Rock 'n' rollers (Chubby Checker, Gene Chandler, Vic Dana) put on a TV dance special.

title: Diamond Head
description: The head (Charlton Heston) of a Hawaiian pineapple dynasty refuses to let his sister (Yvette Mimieux) marry a native.

title: Boston Blackie and the Law
description: Reformed thief Blackie (Chester Morris) does a magic show in a women's prison, during which an inmate escapes.

title: Let's Do It Again
description: A composer's (Ray Milland) singing-and-dancing wife (Jane Wyman) tries to make him jealous, but it backfires into a divorce.

title: The Doctor Takes a Wife
description: A writer (Loretta Young) and a neurologist (Ray Milland) accept rumors of their marriage when each stands to gain from the mistake.

title: Paula
description: A boy left mute by a hit-and-run accident discovers his speech teacher (Loretta Young) was the driver.

title: Gidget
description: A California girl called Gidget (Sandra Dee) spends summer with surf bums called Moondoggie (James Darren) and Kahuna (Cliff Robertson).

title: The Mating of Millie
description: A businesswoman (Evelyn Keyes) asks a bachelor (Glenn Ford) to help her find a husband so she can adopt an orphan.

title: Funny Girl
description: Ziegfeld Follies star Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) falls for gambler Nicky Arnstein (Omar Sharif).

title: Oliver!
description: Dickens' Oliver Twist goes from parish boy to Fagin's pickpocketing school to the clutches of murderous Bill Sikes.

title: It Happened One Night
description: A newsman (Clark Gable) rides a bus and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Walter Connolly) runaway daughter (Claudette Colbert).

title: Gidget Grows Up
description: Gidget goes to New York, becomes a U.N. guide and meets an older man.

title: The Happy Time
description: A violinist (Charles Boyer) and his brother (Louis Jourdan) guide one's son through his crush on the family maid in the 1920s Ottawa.

title: The Howards of Virginia
description: Politics divide a Williamsburg couple (Cary Grant, Martha Scott) as events lead to the Revolutionary War.

title: You Can't Run Away From It
description: A newsman (Jack Lemmon) rides a bus, hitchhikes and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Charles Bickford) runaway daughter (June Allyson).
